_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ssti#2 — a FALSIFICATION. The entry demanded matching TIMESTEP across STRUCTURAL, SCALAR TRANSPORT and THERMAL DYNAMIC and predicted a several-percent splitting error otherwise. There is nothing to match: SSTI takes one time step, from SSTI CONTROL, and overrides the per-field values silently. On upstream ssti_mono_3D_3hex8_elch_s2i_butlervolmerthermo_growthlaw.4C.yaml, injecting TIMESTEP 0.7 / NUMSTEP 3 into STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC and TIMESTEP 0.9 / NUMSTEP 2 into SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC leaves every result test passing and produces no warning at all. Halving SSTI CONTROL's own TIMESTEP is the control arm and does move the results, proving the deck is time-step sensitive. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the discriminating arm: leave SSTI CONTROL's TIMESTEP alone. The control that proves the deck is time-step sensitive disappears — SSTIDT_RESULT_TEST_FAILURES becomes 0, EXIT_SSTIDT becomes 0 and no result-test failure line is printed — so the fixture must go red.
